title: Agent Result Observer Roadmap
goal: Give agents result sense: execute checks, observe visual state, compare evidence and decide whether work actually succeeded.
no_gpu_strategy: Use Chromium headless with software rendering for normal websites and UI.
Use Xvfb only when a headed browser or noVNC session is required.
Use SwiftShader or software WebGL for light WebGL cases.
Mark heavy 3D/game workloads as degraded without GPU.

slice_queue.goal: Define normalized result artifacts for command output, screenshots, DOM, console, network and traces.
Define when screenshot/DOM changes count as success, warning or failure.
Specify sampled frame observation and optional noVNC human-watch mode without requiring GPU.
Run a sandboxed visual smoke and collect screenshot, console and network artifacts.

done_definition: Agent can report what changed visually and technically.
Result evidence is bounded and redacted.
Live watch does not require GPU.
Raw video streaming is optional and operator-facing, not a default model input.
